A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we introduce the first large-scale multi-label learning for the visual search system in the fashion domain, and we show that our system is able to achieve the top 5 accuracy of 0.75 on our large-scale dataset.
we have built the largest-scale visual search engine which can find similar products with the end-toend manner.

the RNNs can be applied to the real-world applications, which requires the multi-label learning and the end-to-end training.
